pages.text: A glowing lake region: lava pools rimmed with obsidian, $(l)obsidian islands$() floating on the lava sea, spires of obsidian and crying obsidian, and floors of $(item)Molten Glass$() (hot: it burns like magma).$(br2)$(item)Molten Crystals$() give $(item)Molten Glass Shards$(), used for the $(l)Nether Lantern$(). Watch out for $(l)Basalt Golems$().
pages.title: Lac de verre en fusion
